address: 2F, Mactan Seaport Village, Punta Engaño Road, Lapu-Lapu, Cebu, 6015, The Philippines
bio: Opened in mid-2024, this easy-to-miss gem on the second floor of an old building blends tropical charm with rustic bamboo decor, stone-accented walls and a laid-back, vacation-like vibe. The Korean owner and young, local kitchen team deliver a menu that mixes Filipino and Thai flavours with creative flair. The highlight is sisig with egg – a flavoursome stir-fry of assorted pork offal and aromatic spices. Cool down with a fresh fruit shake on sunny afternoons.
